_comment: Written from the REQUEST, before the code, by hand. Each outcome states its expectation here — not in the artifact — so deleting the feature cannot delete the requirement.

outcomes.name: submit enables once both fields are filled
outcomes.expect: On an empty form the submit button is disabled. After a valid email and any password are entered, it is enabled.

outcomes.name: a rejected sign-in shows an error and logs nothing
outcomes.expect: The error message is hidden initially, becomes visible after a failed submit, and the console stays clean throughout.
